title: Indexing and Vector Stores
summary: This module provides core functionalities for indexing documents and managing vector stores, including an asynchronous indexing API, in-memory implementations, and utilities for creating vector store indexes. It handles document lifecycle management, hashing, and similarity-based retrieval.

nodes.label: Asynchronously Index Documents
nodes.title: Async Document Indexer
nodes.description: Manages the asynchronous indexing of documents into a vector store or document index, handling additions, updates, and deletions while tracking document state with a record manager. Supports various cleanup strategies.

nodes.label: Hash Data to UUID
nodes.title: Data Hashing Utility
nodes.description: Generates a unique UUID by hashing nested dictionary data using specified algorithms (SHA1, SHA256, SHA512, Blake2b), primarily used for creating stable document identifiers.

nodes.label: Document Index Interface
nodes.title: Abstract Document Index
nodes.description: An abstract base class defining the interface for document indexing systems. It specifies methods for upserting, deleting, and retrieving documents by ID, and inherits from BaseRetriever.

nodes.label: In-Memory Document Index
nodes.title: Ephemeral Document Index
nodes.description: A concrete, in-memory implementation of the Document Index Interface. It stores documents in a dictionary and offers a basic search mechanism based on query term frequency within document content.

nodes.label: In-Memory Vector Store
nodes.title: Ephemeral Vector Store
nodes.description: A concrete, in-memory implementation of a vector store. It stores documents and their embeddings in a dictionary, supporting efficient similarity searches using cosine similarity and various retrieval methods.

nodes.label: Create Vector Store Index
nodes.title: Vector Store Index Builder
nodes.description: A utility class responsible for constructing vector store indexes. It orchestrates the loading of documents, splitting them into chunks, generating embeddings, and populating a chosen vector store.

nodes.label: Provide Default Text Splitter
nodes.title: Default Text Splitter Provider
nodes.description: A helper function that returns a default RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter instance, configured for chunking documents into manageable sizes for indexing.

nodes.label: Vector Store Base
nodes.title: Abstract Vector Store
nodes.description: An abstract base class defining the fundamental interface for all vector store implementations, including methods for adding, deleting, and searching documents by vector similarity.

nodes.label: Base Retriever
nodes.title: Abstract Document Retriever
nodes.description: An abstract base class that defines the common interface for all document retrieval systems, enabling consistent interaction with various data sources.

nodes.label: Document Object
nodes.title: Core Document Structure
nodes.description: Represents a piece of text content along with associated metadata, serving as the fundamental unit for indexing, storage, and retrieval operations within the framework.

nodes.label: Document Loader
nodes.title: Data Ingestion Interface
nodes.description: An abstract base class for components responsible for loading raw data from various sources and converting it into a standardized Document format for further processing.

nodes.label: Embeddings Generator
nodes.title: Text Embedding Service
nodes.description: A component responsible for converting text or documents into numerical vector representations (embeddings), which are crucial for similarity search in vector stores.

nodes.label: Text Splitter
nodes.title: Document Chunking Utility
nodes.description: A utility that breaks down large text documents into smaller, more manageable chunks, often used before indexing to optimize retrieval performance and context window usage.

nodes.label: Record Manager
nodes.title: Document State Tracker
nodes.description: An external component responsible for tracking the state and timestamps of indexed documents, enabling efficient incremental updates and cleanup operations within vector stores.

groups.label: Surface APIs
groups.title: User-Facing Indexing APIs
groups.description: Components that provide high-level, user-facing functionalities for creating and managing document indexes.

groups.label: Core Indexing Logic
groups.title: Document Indexing & Lifecycle Management
groups.description: Central components responsible for the core logic of indexing documents, including hashing, managing document state, and orchestrating upsert/delete operations.

groups.label: Index Implementations
groups.title: Concrete Index & Vector Store Implementations
groups.description: Concrete implementations of the abstract document index and vector store interfaces, providing in-memory storage and retrieval capabilities.

groups.label: Interfaces & Abstractions
groups.title: Abstract Definitions for Indexing
groups.description: Abstract base classes that define the contracts for document indexing and retrieval, allowing for flexible and interchangeable implementations.

groups.label: Helper Utilities
groups.title: Supporting Functions for Indexing
groups.description: Auxiliary functions that provide specific helper functionalities, such as default text splitting.
